Amendments N and P: a latest fail withdraws the class; an attestation exists but none is fresh, so attestation_stale (literal reading, flagged as a gap).

vectors.note: Not every executor is quarantined, so executor_quarantined does not apply.
A fresh attestation exists (below), so attestation_stale does not apply.
Amendment P: a declined offer is a refused placement with the executor's reason; the decline code vocabulary (five codes) is not listed in the ADR.
Amendment P says "no_executor, or the executor's reason"; the ADR text has no offer_expired code.
Rows observed before reenabled_at are invisible to the shared predicate, so no attestation exists for the refusal reason.
The predicate is observed_at > reenabled_at (strict).
Only the runtime-probe rule is satisfied; every other observation still has to pass.
Amendment V names the value 1 only; other truthy spellings are unspecified.
Amendment W orders bh, jti and lookup after the body; whether a bh mismatch consumes the jti is unspecified.
A child that names no class inherits its parent's: it never runs looser (decision 8: a child's class must be at least its parent's).
A parent with no isolation class constrains nothing; the child's own class is stored.
Relaxing the confidential sensitivity floor to L1 does not lower code_exec: its own floor is L3 for confidential and regulated projects.
The mcp_stdio floor relaxed to L1 (audited, step-up) lowers only that floor: the strict public sensitivity floor still requires L2.
With every floor relaxed to L1 by an admin, a hardened container satisfies the call; nothing is ever placed at L0.
An agent with no identity runs only under the most restrictive profile (L3), whatever looser profile it was assigned; an L2 executor cannot take it.
Review M1: the placement required L3; an executor now attesting only L2 no longer holds it, even though the grant named L2.
The grant requires L3: an L2 attestation fails it whatever the placement required.
The control: an active, fresh executor attesting at the stricter of the two classes keeps the actor live.
A call with no agent made with a person's API key is an unknown agent at L3 even where the server is relaxed: the relaxation is for an interactive session only (owner decision C).
A person's own call (no agent) from an interactive session in a relaxed project: the unknown-agent floor is L2 (owner decision C).
The default: with no relaxation in scope a person's own call is the unknown agent at L3 (owner decision C).
A low-assurance agent is never relaxed, even when an interactive person sponsors it (owner decision C).
